description: Source code for the ClearKey DRM plugin implementation, including session management, property handling, and key request processing.

classes.name: DrmPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of a DRM plugin for ClearKey, managing sessions, properties, and key requests.

methods.name: initProperties
methods.description: Initializes DRM plugin properties such as vendor, version, and algorithms.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session and returns its session ID.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes an existing DRM session identified by session ID.

methods.name: getKeyRequest
methods.description: Generates a key request for license acquisition.

methods.name: setPlayPolicy
methods.description: Sets the play policy parameters such as license type and permissions.

methods.name: provideKeyResponse
methods.description: Provides a key response to the session and updates play policy.

methods.name: getPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Retrieves a byte array property value.

methods.name: setPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Sets a byte array property value.

methods.name: queryKeyStatus
methods.description: Queries the current key status and policy information.
